rule1: No AI Quirk. No Meme Logic. No Filler.
provenanceCaveats: #kfb and #cutplay are public analog/meta origin references, #thegame is public game orientation; main/index.html navigation source confirmed but exact live Cloudflare visual response unverified
Never attribute analog Quest Die or Freestyle Social Call rules as proven current digital runtime implementation
Dystopia IGNORE; Utopia FORGET; Protopia EMBRACE; Town historic hub, not fourth future deck
Do not claim all Residents know the cosmic Hunky/Dory/Academy framing
All premises are satire/writer proposals, never newly adopted gameplay/lore
Clown source only verifies candidate three-club state; two-club performance and staging remain unverified
Suno Speech beta output may alter words/pacing; actual transcript, duration, mixed music and rights require source file review
KFB Audio exclusively owns playback/ducking; preserve ChatterBox semantics and Residence stage rigs

awarenessScale.1: In-world character affected by local events; no omniscient audience lecture
awarenessScale.2: Knowledgeable narrator/ruler about story, cards, or prior encounters, confined to character
awarenessScale.3: Higher cosmic backstage perspective permitted only for named lore authorities
